geometry.coverage_threshold: No 50-percent coverage cutoff for population inclusion. Record overlap fractions and >=50% smaller-footprint status diagnostically.
geometry.sky_intersection: Project both four-corner STC polygons to a shared gnomonic tangent plane and convex-clip them. Require strictly positive intersection area.
geometry.solution_association: Within the same physical plate, among solutions belonging to scans with filenames and valid STC polygons, choose smallest angular separation between parent exposure ra_icrs/dec_icrs and solution center; ties prefer larger num_xmatch then smaller solution_id. If fov1/fov2 exist, require separation <= max(1 deg, 0.75*hypot(fov1,fov2)).

known_aggregate_outcome_context_at_freez.v094d: fragment-aware timing repair completed with zero v093 reconstruction mismatches
known_aggregate_outcome_context_at_freez.v094e_to_v094g1: aggregate diagnostics localized the v094c excess to persistent-source/marginal-extraction/unqualified-control-nondetection pathology

population_definition.ambiguous_site: Hold exposures with missing site_name from the primary cross-site denominator rather than inferring a site from archive or coordinates.
population_definition.digital_footprint: Require a plausible astrometric solution associated by the frozen v093 rule and a positive STC-polygon intersection.
population_definition.fragment_timing: Use v094d fragment_intervals_json exactly. For multi-sub exposures, only structurally supported exposure_sub intervals may contribute. Do not collapse discontinuous fragments to a parent envelope.
population_definition.known_coordinate_semantics: Apply the frozen v093e Bamberg longitude/latitude swap; otherwise use APPLAUSE site_longitude/site_latitude as named and label whether the site semantics were previously validated in v093e. Baseline is diagnostic only.
population_definition.parent_coordinates: ra_icrs/dec_icrs required for exposure-to-solution association. Scan/solution coordinates may not substitute for missing parent coordinates.
population_definition.same_site: Retain only as aggregate co-site replication context; do not call it independent cross-observatory evidence.
population_definition.site_distance: Record great-circle baseline diagnostically where coordinates are available. Distance never determines inclusion.
population_definition.site_identity: Primary cross-site inclusion requires two non-empty normalized plate.site_name values that differ. No minimum distance threshold.
population_definition.source_universe: all 139,539 APPLAUSE DR4 exposures in frozen v094d master registry

scientific_role: Fresh metadata-only observing-opportunity denominator. v094c is preserved as an exploratory failure mode and is not an input population.
stop_rule: Stop after the opportunity census and interpret population/site/timing/geometry holds before any source-level search.

time_gates.midpoint: may be retained as secondary metadata only; never used for gate membership
time_gates.overlap: record every positive-duration continuous-fragment intersection interval for the exposure pair
time_gates.primary_metric: minimum actual continuous-fragment interval gap; zero if fragments overlap
